title: Second-customer tenant template via prism_tenant
brief: Pilot is JM Die only per MS19. Second-customer onboarding is open decision #4 from V1, never owned. Risk auditor flagged JM Die concentration risk: customer churn = whole pilot dies. This MS templatizes onboarding so a second tenant can stand up in <1 day.

phases.title: Tenant template + isolated registries + onboarding wizard

units.title: TenantTemplateEngine: clone JM Die config to new tenant scaffold
exit_conditions: new tenant scaffold created at state/tenants/<tenantId>/ with isolated machines, materials, customers
no JM Die data leaks across tenants
tests: new tenant has zero records pre-import
units.description: Reuse existing prism_tenant dispatcher. Add cloning logic.

units.title: Tenant-scoped registries + tenant_id propagation
exit_conditions: cross-tenant query requires explicit override + audit
units.description: Schema bump on registries -> migration via MS27 runner.

units.title: Onboarding wizard: machines, customers, programs in <1 day
exit_conditions: wizard ingests 1 machine list + 1 customer list + N programs
first quote-to-ship cycle runnable within 8 hours of onboarding start
units.description: Real onboarding rehearsal validates the template.

acceptance: new tenant onboarded in <1 day with isolated data + tenant-scoped registries; first quote-to-ship cycle runs within 8h of onboarding; resolves V1 decision #4 (pilot scope).

risks.description: Tenant_id missing from existing engine SQL/JSON queries; mitigation = audit pass per MS27 migration
JM Die concentration risk (per Pass-2 risk auditor) means MS29 should arguably be PRE-MS19 not POST; flagged for V3 decision
